'''Mayli Weng''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] representing the [[Exotic Entertainers' Union]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. 
==Biography==
Mayli Weng began her professional journey as an exotic entertainer in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Known for her charm, poise, and commanding presence, she quickly ascended within the ranks of the industry. Her natural leadership and diplomatic acumen caught the attention of the [[Exotic Entertainers' Union]], eventually leading to her appointment as one of its senior representatives.<ref name="sotes">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Around that time she had quit using [[spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="flame">{{WEGCite|story=An Old Flame in Need...|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

By the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Weng was serving as a senior union representative based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Representing the interests of over 20,000 workers across the Core Worlds, Weng entered the [[Coruscanti]] elite. She was tasked with lobbying politicians, negotiating on behalf of entertainers, and maintaining relationships with industry executives and powerful figures even within the [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]]. She was known for her impassioned defense of her colleagues and for her firm opposition against governmental outreach. Apart of that, she was careful so that her industry did not threaten [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] operations, as her colleagues worked in businesses controlled or influenced by Black Sun. She frequently reported to [[Underlord/Legends|Underlord]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], and the [[Dark Prince]] occasionally used his influence to pressure the [[Entertainment Owners' League]] into granting concessions favorable to the Union.<ref name="sotes" />

By [[3 BBY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], Weng was concerned about some Union members on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], being detained under accusations of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathies, and of those on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] who were harrassed by [[cadet/Legends|cadets]] of [[Corulag Academy|the Academy]]; meanwhile the [[Esselian Hall]] attempted to regulate local entertainment outside the auspices of the Union.<ref name="flame" />

During a high-profile reception on Coruscant, Mayli was involved in her political maneuvering, hoping to meet [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Zafiel Snopps]] of Corulag and representatives of the [[Esseles/Legends|Esselian]] government to address the issues. While she was trapped in a less-than-pleasant conversation, she encountered an old romantic acquaintance, [[Wendell Wright-Sims]], a [[spice merchant]] and socialite. Their exchange was tinged with flirtation, unresolved feelings, and professional tension, as Wendell attempted to rekindle their former relationship while she remained focused on union business. Weng brushed off his advances, demonstrating her commitment to her responsibilities. Wendell further attempted to calm her by reciting [[Adranax]].<ref name="flame" />

==Personality and traits==
Mayli Weng was elegant and charismatic. Through intelligence, diplomacy, and persistence, she secured a prominent administrative role within the Union and became an influential advocate for workers. Her conversational dexterity and seductive charm masked a deeply capable mind skilled in political negotiation.<ref name="sotes" /> 

She became known for her exceptional beauty, luxurious fashion, polished demeanor, and melodic voice. Rumors circulated that she employed assistants solely to style her famously long brown hair before public appearances.<ref name="sotes" /> 

In private, however, she reportedly struggled with isolation and found her life on Coruscant hollow despite its glamor.<ref name="sotes" />  
==Powers and abilities==
Mayli was a skilled bargainer and negotiator, able to manipulate conversations to her favor even among powerful Imperial and underworld figures. She was also trained in subterfuge and could detect hidden motives and evade surveillance or manipulation with ease.

==Equipment==
She was often seen with a business data pad and wearing a exotic dresses.
